args: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || exit 1; pw=$(grep -E '^DB_RO_PASSWORD=' backend/.env | head -n1 | cut -d= -f2-); if [ -z "$pw" ]; then echo 'DB_RO_PASSWORD no está en backend/.env' >&2; exit 1; fi; DB_RO_PASSWORD="$pw" exec npx -y @bytebase/dbhub@1.4.0 --config=backend/database/dbhub.toml
